# v0.5.1 - Short install and CLI command

This release makes Codex Task Queue easier to try and share.

## Highlights

- Adds `package.json` with a `codex-task-queue` CLI binary.
- Supports global installation directly from GitHub:

```bash
npm install -g github:Grey-G/codex-task-queue
codex-task-queue doctor
```

- Supports one-off runs without global installation:

```bash
npx --yes github:Grey-G/codex-task-queue doctor
```

- Updates README examples to lead with the short command instead of the long `node /path/to/...` invocation.
- Updates CLI help output to show `codex-task-queue <doctor|init|next|run|history>`.

## Verification

Validated package install, help output, dry-run packaging, and tests:

```bash
npm install --prefix /tmp/codex-task-queue-install-test .
/tmp/codex-task-queue-install-test/node_modules/.bin/codex-task-queue help
npm run pack:dry-run
npm test
```
